items.title: Stability and Variability of DNA (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Stability and Variability of DNA: a main subheading of 19.3.3 Mechanism of DNA Replication, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 129-129.

blocks.text: Yeh replicate hone wale DNA ki do ahem khoobiyan hain. “Stability” (pakka pan) ka matlab hai DNA ka bilkul durust copy hona. DNA polymerase III (aur eukaryotic polymerases) mein "proofreading" (ghalti pakar kar theek karne) ki salahiyat hoti hai jis se nucleotides ka sequence wahi rehta hai. Yeh yaksaniyat bohat zaroori hai kyun ke is se jandar ki khaas khasiyatein (traits) qaim rehti hain aur cells theek kaam karte hain.

Stability qaida hai aur “variability” (tabdeeli) istisna (exception). Kabhi kabhi DNA sequence mein mustaqil tabdeeli aa jati hai jise mutation kehte hain. Mutations replication ki ghaltiyon se bhi hoti hain aur mahol ke asraat (environmental factors) se bhi. Variability nayi khasiyaton ka bunyadi zariya hai; is se populations badalte mahol mein dhal sakti hain, aur yahi evolution ka khaam maal hai.

blocks.prompt: Lagging strand tukron (Okazaki fragments) mein kyun banta hai?
blocks.explanation: DNA polymerase III sirf 3′ sire par nucleotide jor sakta hai, yaani strand sirf 5′ se 3′ barhta hai. Lagging template par yeh simt fork se door hai, is liye jaise jaise fork khulta hai, enzyme ko naye primer se dobara shuru karna parta hai aur chhote tukre bante hain.

items: Helicase strands kholta; gyrase supercoiling rokta; single-strand binding proteins strands alag rakhte; primase RNA primer lagata.
DNA polymerase III 5′ se 3′ jorta: leading strand musalsal, lagging strand Okazaki fragments mein.
DNA polymerase I primers hata kar khaali jagah bharta; DNA ligase fragments jorta; proofreading se stability.
